answer: Randomness-Gated Entry Lottery. Each epoch, a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon assigns every agent a secret slot; only agents whose slot ripples into the active set may transact. An attacker cannot precompute which clones will qualify, since the beacon output is unknown until reveal. To hold many identities, they must maintain all of them through falcon-fast idle epochs, paying full compute and storage costs each round while most stay dormant. A zephyr of churn reveals clusters of synchronized silent identities, which are flagged and dropped.
